subject: A simple explainer about how plants convert sunlight into energy

scenes.narrator: Every single day, plants perform an incredible chemical reaction that powers nearly all life on Earth.
scenes.scene_overview: Hook the viewer by revealing the hidden power of plants

visuals.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of a vibrant green leaf with sunlight streaming through, showing translucent veins and chlorophyll cells, macro photography style, warm golden light
visuals.animation_prompt: Camera slowly pushes in as sunlight beams intensify through the leaf, particles of light drift downward

scenes.narrator: That process is called photosynthesis, and without it, life as we know it simply would not exist.
scenes.scene_overview: Name the process and leave the viewer with a sense of awe
